author: Ellen G. White
text: Jesus opened them, and I saw the ten commandments written on them with the finger of God. … But the fourth (the Sabbath commandment,) shone above them all; for the Sabbath was set apart to be kept in honor of God’s holy name. … I saw that the Sabbath was not nailed to the cross. … But the Pope had changed it from the seventh to the first day of the week; for he was to change times and laws.
note: Earliest print of the vision: the Decalogue on the tables in the heavenly ark, the Sabbath commandment glorified, 'not nailed to the cross', and the papal change read as Dan 7:25's 'change times and laws' (Principles XI, XIII).

author: Uriah Smith
text: This took place at the end of the 2300 days, when the sanctuary was to be cleansed, the time when the prophetic periods expired, and the seventh angel commenced to sound. Since that time, the people of God have seen by faith the open door in heaven, and the ark of God’s testament there. They are endeavoring to keep every precept of the holy law written upon the tables therein deposited. … Yet John, beholding the ark in heaven under the sounding of the seventh trumpet, still calls it the “ark of his testament,” affording unanswerable proof that the law is still there, unaltered in one jot or tittle from the copy which for a time was committed to the care of men in the typical ark of the tabernacle during the Mosaic dispensation.
note: Rev 11:19: the ark seen in heaven from the end of the 2300 days proves the Ten Commandments stand there unaltered — Principle XI's 'transcript of the tables deposited in the ark'.

author: J. N. Andrews
work: Thoughts on the Sabbath & the Perpetuity of the Law of God
text: It was instituted in Paradise. Genesis 2. … We look forward to Paradise restored, and there stands the holy Sabbath. Isaiah 66:22, 23. … The Sabbath was made for man; it began with the first man, and continues notwithstanding the “man of sin,” inseparably connected with the history of the human family forever.
note: Principle XII's arc in one paragraph: the Sabbath set apart in Paradise, standing in Paradise restored, and outlasting the 'man of sin'.

author: Joseph Bates
work: A Seal of the Living God
text: This being the signification of a sign, it is the same as seal. God says that he gave the Sabbath for a perpetual covenant and “a sign (or seal) between him and the children of Israel forever. (His reasons for it are,) for, (or because) in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested and was refreshed.” - Exodus 31:17. How evident it is to any person of sane mind, that God gave this sign at the same time that he made the Sabbath, viz: on the seventh day of creation; not for the tribes of Israel only that lived in the days of Moses, but for the whole Israel of God, from Adam to the resurrection of the righteous dead. This sign then was given twenty-five hundred years before there was a descendant of Jacob on the earth.
note: The Sabbath 'sign' is a 'seal', given at creation for 'the whole Israel of God' from Adam — 2,500 years before Jacob, so not a Jewish-only token.

author: James White
work: The Seventh Day Sabbath Not Abolished (review of Joseph Marsh's “Seventh-day Sabbath Abolished”)
text: Those who talk of “the Jewish Sabbath,” and “the Christian Sabbath” do not talk the language of the Holy Scriptures; for the only weekly Sabbath of the Bible is “the Sabbath of the LORD thy GOD.” It is also called “MY holy day,” “the holy of the LORD,” (see Isaiah 58:13.) “THY holy Sabbath,” (see Nehemiah 9:14,) and “THE Sabbath.”
note: White's own reply (not Marsh's quoted text): 'Jewish Sabbath' and 'Christian Sabbath' are not Bible names, the point Principle XII words as 'names of human invention'.

author: James White
work: The Seventh Day Sabbath Not Abolished (review of Joseph Marsh's “Seventh-day Sabbath Abolished”)
text: All shadows cease when they reach their bodies which cast them. Follow the shadow of a tree to its body, and there the shadow ends. But as the weekly Sabbath will never end, it is not a shadow; but a body of itself; as well as the other nine commandments, for they are all of the same nature.
note: Answers the 'shadow' reading of Col 2:16-17: a weekly Sabbath that never ends (Isa 66:22-23, SDSNA 16.1-16.4) cannot be a shadow.
